basics.name: Anand Bhaskaran
basics.label: Senior AI Engineer | Agentic Systems & Knowledge Graphs | Production LLM Platforms
basics.summary: AI engineer who ships agents that act, not just dashboards that report. Built AI Brain at LumApps, a knowledge-graph context layer (Neo4j, Graphiti, Zep) that grounds production agents with business intelligence to drive company's strategy. 12+ years turning messy data into product capability: outbound agents that 2x sales conversions, LLM pipelines that eliminated $337K in cost, search platforms serving 10M+ users. Founder mindset for open problems, Zurich-based.

work.name: LumApps
work.summary: Owns AI transformation end-to-end, from production AI agent architecture to knowledge graph foundations and company-wide governance. Reports directly to C-level on outcomes.
highlights: Built AI Brain, a knowledge-graph context layer (Neo4j, Graphiti, Zep) that unifies conversation data, usage analytics, and notes into structured, queryable intelligence. Grounds production AI agents and surfaces business patterns that drive company strategy across product, sales, and CS.

Built and deployed production AI agents for outbound sales. 2x open rates, 2x approved opportunities, 2 to 3 hours saved per rep per day. Forecast to generate $4M in approved opportunities per quarter; that is $1M in quarterly revenue.
Designed agentic workflows end-to-end: tool design, reasoning loops, grounding, context windows. Owned architecture (Python, LangChain, FastAPI, GCP), telemetry (Langfuse), and rollout.

work.name: Beekeeper AG
work.summary: Technical lead who operates like a founding engineer. Owns the problem, designs the data and system, ships to prod, stays accountable to the metric. Built AI-powered products used by 10M+ frontline workers.
highlights: Replaced $337K in annual translation costs with an LLM pipeline built in 6 weeks. 12K+ assets translated; product team now iterates without external gatekeepers. Classic case of building the data infrastructure that turns information into capability.

Led Search Platform revamp across 3 teams. Redesigned indexing, ranking, and retrieval to surface what users mean to find, not just what they typed. Measurable lift in engagement; foundation for downstream embeddings and semantic search work.
Built GenAI demo system for sales. Auto-generates personalized content from structured Salesforce data so every pitch feels custom-built. Improved demo speed and close rates.
Built AI Onboarding Specialist giving every new signup personalized, high-touch guidance at scale. 100% of customers guided through setup, time-to-first-value reduced without adding headcount.

work.name: Tenity
work.summary: Technology panelist and mentor for seed-to-VC stage startups. Evaluates technical architecture and advises on AI adoption, agentic workflows, and building systems that scale.
highlights: Evaluated 20+ startups on AI readiness, data architecture, and scalability to inform seed-to-VC investment decisions.
Advised portfolio companies on AI agent design, data strategy, and turning signals into shippable product intelligence.

work.name: Dronistics
work.summary: Founding engineer for an autonomous drone delivery system. Built everything from scratch: data model, APIs, infrastructure, and the algorithms that made 500+ real-world deliveries possible.
highlights: Shipped end-to-end autonomous delivery platform (Vue, Java, PostgreSQL). 500+ successful deliveries; every flight a live test for autonomous decision systems in the real world.
Engineered real-time flight control APIs and logistics optimization algorithms. 40% faster deliveries, 99.5% safety record, zero incidents. Partnerships with Unilever and a CES showcase.

work.name: EPFL, Laboratory of Intelligent Systems (Robogen)
work.summary: AI research at the frontier of robotics. Built and scaled Robogen, an open-source platform for co-evolution of robot morphologies and control systems via genetic algorithms. Foundational AI work that underpins my current LLM and agentic systems craft.
highlights: Engineered Robogen, an open-source platform for co-evolution of robot bodies and brains via genetic algorithms. Rare research direction where morphology and neural control evolve together through artificial selection.
Migrated the simulation pipeline to AWS for large-scale parallel evolution runs impractical on local hardware. Secured AWS Cloud Credits for Research; work featured on the AWS Public Sector Blog.
Foundational AI experience (optimization, search, fitness landscapes, learning from environment) that informs how I approach modern agentic systems today.

projects.name: PulseView - AI Market Intelligence
projects.description: Built for my own trading portfolio first: a platform where AI agents generate AND justify trading signals using technical and news-based data. Retail traders deserve the same explainable analysis institutions pay for.
highlights: Real-time market analysis via AI agents that generate signals AND explain them. Core principle: if the model can't justify the signal, it doesn't ship.
Opened to retail traders after self-validating. Live users, real money, real feedback loops on agent quality.

projects.name: Proplab - AI Real Estate Tools
projects.description: Property inspections still run on paper, clipboards, and WhatsApp photos. Built an MVP that turns the entire workflow into structured, image-backed, timestamped data that AI can actually reason over.
highlights: Shipped MVP replacing paper-based workflows with structured, queryable inspection records. Data atoms designed for downstream AI use.
Building AI marketing assistant that auto-generates listings from inspection data. Structured input, agentic output, zero copy-paste.

projects.name: SwissNRI - Cross-border Fintech Platform
projects.description: Swiss-Indian families navigating FEMA, DTAA, and Swiss regulations had zero digital help. Just spreadsheets and expensive advisors. Built the first platform addressing this.
highlights: Zero-to-MVP in 3 months. Early users acquired through Swiss-Indian community partnerships.
Compliance-first design: regulatory guardrails built before features. 40% uplift in customer satisfaction from feedback-driven iteration.

_jobApplication.jobDescription: Senior AI & Data Product Engineer at Orderfox (Zurich, Hybrid). Build AI agents that act on manufacturing data: knowledge graph (Neo4j) grounding, manufacturing ontology design, data atoms for agent workflows, vertical expansion across CNC/injection moulding/sheet metal/additive, missing-data sourcing via APIs/crawling/ML inference, telemetry (LangSmith, PostHog). Required: 5+ years product analytics or data science in B2B SaaS/AI; SQL + Python; agentic workflows as daily toolkit; knowledge graphs and ontology design; Azure stack (Fabric, Synapse, OneLake, Azure ML, AI Search). Stand out with manufacturing experience, embeddings/vector ops, data procurement. Swiss/EU/EFTA citizen or valid Swiss work permit; on-site Zurich.
